results.name: Plate Overhead Walking Lunge
instructions: Press a weight plate overhead with both hands, arms locked out.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are at about 90 degrees.
Step through into the next lunge, keeping the plate overhead.
tips: Keep your ribs down and core braced.
Keep the plate directly over your head.
results.description: Plate Overhead Walking Lunge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Core, Hamstrings.

results.name: Plate Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg, holding a weight plate in front of your thighs.
Hinge at your hips and extend your free leg straight back.
Lower the plate toward the floor with a flat back.
Return to standing, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your hips square.
Keep a soft bend in the standing knee.
results.description: Plate Single Leg Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Plate Single Leg Pinch Grip Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg, pinching a weight plate in the opposite hand.
Hinge at your hips and extend your free leg back.
Lower the plate toward the floor with a flat back.
Stand back up and repeat, then switch sides.
tips: A good balance and grip challenge; use a light plate.
Keep your hips level.
results.description: Plate Single Leg Pinch Grip Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Plate Squat Hold Biceps Curl
instructions: Squat down and hold the bottom position, gripping a weight plate in front of you with arms extended.
Keep your chest up and heels down.
Curl the plate up toward your chest.
Lower it with control and repeat while holding the squat.
tips: Don't let your chest drop as you curl.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
results.description: Plate Squat Hold Biceps Curl is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Forearms.

results.name: Plate Squat Hold Reach
instructions: Squat down and hold the bottom position with a weight plate at your chest.
Press the plate straight out in front of you.
Bring it back to your chest.
Repeat while holding the squat.
tips: Keep your heels down.
Brace your core as you reach.
results.description: Plate Squat Hold Reach is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Core.

results.name: Plate Squat Hold
instructions: Hold a weight plate at your chest.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Hold the bottom position with your chest up and heels down.
Hold for the set time, then stand up.
tips: Keep your knees in line with your toes.
Breathe steadily during the hold.
results.description: Plate Squat Hold is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core.

results.name: Plate Squat Reach
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate at your chest.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
As you stand, press the plate straight out in front of you.
Bring it back to your chest and repeat.
tips: Move smoothly from squat to reach.
Keep your core braced.
results.description: Plate Squat Reach is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Core.

results.name: Plate Staggered Deadlift
instructions: Stand with one foot slightly behind the other, holding a weight plate in front of your thighs.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at your hips to lower the plate along your front leg with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch legs.
tips: The back foot is for balance only.
Keep the plate close to your leg.
results.description: Plate Staggered Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

results.name: Plate Staggered Pinch Grip Deadlift
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance, pinching a weight plate in one hand.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at your hips to lower the plate with a flat back.
Stand back up and repeat, then switch sides.
tips: Squeeze the plate hard.
Keep your shoulders level.
results.description: Plate Staggered Pinch Grip Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Lower Back.

results.name: Resistance Band Bent Leg Kickback (Kneeling)
instructions: Place a loop resistance band around both thighs, just above your knees. Start in a kneeling position on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Engage your core and keep your back flat. Begin with your left knee bent at a 90-degree angle and your foot flexed.
Push your left foot upward towards the ceiling while keeping your knee bent, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
Slowly return your leg to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the right leg.
tips: Use a loop resistance band that provides enough tension to challenge your muscles without compromising form.
Exhale as you kick your leg back and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
Focus on engaging your glutes throughout the movement.
results.description: Resistance Band Bent Leg Kickback (Kneeling) is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back, Core.
